title: Heart (n = 50)
body: ACDC test set, end-diastolic cine CMR, 10 per group: NOR, DCM, HCM, MINF, ARV

title: Constructions S x M
body: S: expert labels (reference)    + 4 segmentation networks M: 1.5 mm and 1.0 mm Up to 10 per heart (494 in all) Fast layer: A2 (primary), B1

title: Forward model
body: Eikonal activation, fixed rules for fibres and root nodes 8-lead QRS in reference torso (Malik 09), one rigid transform per heart

title: Calibration
body: Spline emulator, 9 x 9 log grid, refinement runs; Fit $\theta$ = ($v_\mathrm{endo}$, $v_\mathrm{t}$) Loss: correlation (primary), amplitude (secondary) Output: $\hat{\theta}/\theta^*$ and its CV across constructions

title: Truth draws $\theta^*$
body: 3 per heart (Latin hypercube) Targets simulated on the reference construction

title: Arm N: target noise
body: White and 40 Hz band-limited noise, baseline wander, electrode displacement; reference emulator; break-even level against arm C

title: Arm F: model form (10 hearts)
body: Targets from reaction-eikonal ECGs, calibrated with the eikonal emulator

title: Arm T: torso (22 heart-in-torso models)
body: Targets in own torso, calibration in reference torso 09 or 17; registration translation only (primary) or ICP
